## 🧭 族谱注记 · R+52 —— 本卡属 **gate-派生缺陷类**,索引在 **#13333**(已关闭,但仍是存档点)

⚠️ 本卡**尚未定级**。本注记先于定级贴出。

**本卡在族谱里的位置:支 ②「输出不可信」** —— 捏造的 watch hint `scripts/scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs`:一条本该从仓根运行的补救命令被按**模块相对**解析,前缀翻倍 ⇒ 工具**凭空造出一个从不存在的路径**。

### ⭐ 本卡被 PR #13501 **点名为尚未解决**

那个 PR 落地了族谱支 ① 的一半(always-runs tail),而它在 header 里**逐字点了本卡的号**:

> *It says nothing about derivation on a stale tree (#13392), **fabricated leads (#13312, #13449)** or downstream truncation (#13462) … so **a green tail is not read as the class being closed**.*

⇒ ⛔ **不得**以"#13333 已关闭"为由压低本卡或关掉它。⭐ 而且**一个执行者已经在它自己的 PR 里替本卡划了保留地** —— 那是本席见过最好的一种交接。

### 支 ② 现状:**3 关 / 2 开**

#13392 ✅ · #13312 ✅ · #13461 ✅;**余 #13449(本卡)· #13448**。

⚠️ **#13312 已关闭**,而它与本卡是**同一形态**(捏造线索 / 捏造 hint)⇒ ⭐ 定级本卡前**先读 #13312 的关闭 PR** —— 它很可能已经建立了可复用的修法形制,甚至可能已顺带覆盖本卡。⛔ 若已覆盖,本卡应关闭而非再开一个 PR。

⚠️ 归属按标题与 R+49 族谱判定,⛔ 本席未读本卡正文 ⇒ 须自行复核(R+49 按标题归并的错误率实测约 11%,已记在 #13333)。

## 分诊定级(R+69):**晋级 `pm:queue`** · `domain:devx` · `tooling` · `priority:p2` · type `Bug`

`finding` 摘除(定级即离标)。落点 **`scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs`**(不是 `dispatch-gates.mjs` —— 见下)。

## 分诊现验:零命中成立,且我把源头那行读出来了

```
git ls-files 'scripts/scripts/*'  →  0      (对照 git ls-files 'scripts/*' → 297 ⇒ 零是真零)
```

`origin/main:scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs` :459 附近的原文:

```js
"      node -e \"import('./scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs').then(m=>console.log(m.headingIds(...)))\"\n"
```

⇒ **卡的诊断逐字成立**:这是一条**给人从仓根跑的 remedy 命令**,里面含一个引号包裹的路径形字面量 `./scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs`;hint 抽取器按**模块相对**解析它,于是前缀翻倍成 `scripts/scripts/…`。

⭐ 卡对这件事的表述本席收作口径:**两半各自都没错** —— remedy 串对它的读者是对的,抽取器对一条声明是对的。**捏造来自其中一个被当作另一个来读。**

## ⛔ 修法方向已被上游测量锁死,派发令必须带

⚠️ **不得通过收紧抽取器来修。** #13312 已实测:被许可的声明写法与偶然的模块级常量**结构上不可区分**,收紧的代价是 **每移除 1 个捏造要删掉 8.6 个真实 population**。

⇒ **正解是本地的**:把 remedy 串写成**不可能被读作声明**的形状(例如不让路径以引号包裹的路径形字面量出现 —— 从变量拼装,或改用非相对写法)。⛔ 交付里不得出现对 `dispatch-gates.mjs` 抽取逻辑的改动。

## ⛔ 与 #13448 **不折叠**(家族准入五门第①门不过)

两张同出一次普查(#13312 / PR #13447)、同一个立卡人、症状同类,但**缺陷形态与修法不同**:

| | #13448 | 本卡 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 缺陷 | 覆盖谓词跟不上 glob 形状 | 一条给人读的散文被当成声明 |
| 落点 | `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` | `scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs` |
| 是否移动裁决 | **是**(族匹配更多卡) | 否(只是撤掉一个永不匹配的字面量) |

⇒ 家族准入第①门要求「同缺陷形态**同修法**」,此处不满足 ⇒ **分别派发**。卡自己也是这么论证的(*"a different cause, and the difference is what makes it separately fixable"*),分诊背书。

## 当前状态(卡已声明,分诊确认)

PR #13447 已把该 hint **标注为 dead** ⇒ 它现在**可见而非静默**。⛔ 那只是显示半边;捏造的字面量仍在声明中,拼写修复属于本卡。

same wave, into `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`** — triage ruled the two ⛔ **not** to be folded
(different defect, different fix). ⛔ **Do not touch `dispatch-gates.mjs`.** That is not just a
scope fence here, it is the ruling itself — see Zone 1.

> ```

> ⇒ **卡的诊断逐字成立**:这是一条**给人从仓根跑的 remedy 命令**,里面含一个引号包裹的路径形字面量
> `./scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs`;hint 抽取器按**模块相对**解析它,于是前缀翻倍成 `scripts/scripts/…`。
>
> ⭐ **两半各自都没错** —— remedy 串对它的读者是对的,抽取器对一条声明是对的。**捏造来自其中一个被当作
> 另一个来读。**
>
> ⛔ **修法方向已被上游测量锁死**:⚠️ **不得通过收紧抽取器来修。** #13312 已实测:被许可的声明写法与偶然的
> 模块级常量**结构上不可区分**,收紧的代价是 **每移除 1 个捏造要删掉 8.6 个真实 population**。
> ⇒ **正解是本地的**:把 remedy 串写成**不可能被读作声明**的形状(例如不让路径以引号包裹的路径形字面量出现
> —— 从变量拼装,或改用非相对写法)。⛔ 交付里不得出现对 `dispatch-gates.mjs` 抽取逻辑的改动。

### Zone 2 — PM 机制假设(⚠️ 须实测;⭐ 我复核了分诊的读数,⛔ 都不是裁决)

- **A2.1 — 我自己重验了,现场仍在。** `origin/main:scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs:459`:
  ```js
  "      node -e \"import('./scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs').then(m=>console.log(m.headingIds(…)))\"\n" +
  ```
  且 `scripts/scripts/` 在册文件数 = **0**(对照 `scripts/` 顶层 218 项 ⇒ 真零)。⇒ 缺陷未被 #13312 的收尾
  PR 顺带覆盖。⚠️ **但仍请你在自己的 ref 上再确认一次** —— 这卡的族谱注记明说过「若已被覆盖,本卡应关闭而不是
  再开 PR」,而那是一个**值得报告的结论**,⛔ 不是失败。
- **A2.2 — ⚠️ 我假设 :459 是唯一一处,⛔ 没有普查。** 同一文件、乃至同族门禁脚本里,可能还有别的 remedy
  串含引号包裹的相对路径。**先普查再动手**,把命中数写进 PR;只修一处而留下同形的第二处,是把这张卡的价值减半。
- **A2.3 — 我假设「从变量拼装」这类写法能骗过抽取器,⛔ 没有验证抽取器到底认什么。** ⚠️ 你必须**先读抽取器的
  判据**,再选一种它证明不会认的写法,并且**证明**它不再被认(改前抽取器吐出这条捏造 hint,改后不吐)。
  ⛔ 「我觉得这样它就不认了」不算交付。⭐ 这也是本卡唯一的反向验证面。
- **A2.4 — 可读性不能倒退。** 那条 remedy 是**给人看的命令**,它现在是正确可粘贴的。⚠️ 任何为了躲抽取器而
  让命令变得不可直接粘贴运行的改法,都是把缺陷从工具转嫁给人。⇒ 改完之后那条命令**仍须能从仓根原样跑通**;
  在 PR 里贴出你实际跑通的那次输出。

### Zone 3 — 建议路线(可选,⛔ 不是指令)

卡把修法形态说得很具体了(不让路径以引号包裹的路径形字面量出现)。⭐ 顺带值得看一眼的是:这个 remedy 串位于
一条 `node -e` 命令里,而 `import()` 的参数天然要求引号 —— 所以「从变量拼装」可能比「换非相对写法」更自然。
两条路都行,⛔ 但都要过 A2.3 的证明。

### Standing constraints

⛔ Worktree-first。⛔ Never `git stash`。⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`。⛔ Governed surface
(`docs/adr/**`、`.claude/**`、`skills/**`、`AGENTS.md`、`CLAUDE.md`)—— 停手并报告。⛔ 不改
`packages/spec/src/**`。⛔ **不改 `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`**(#13448 的领地,同波在飞)。
`scripts/` 不发版 ⇒ `skip-changeset`,但**先查 `Check Changeset` 的实际结论**再贴标签。改门禁脚本会同时触发
该约定的义务与路径推导族 —— **两边都跑**。逐项按 GREEN / RED / NOT MEASURED 报告你**实际看到的退出码**
(⛔ 不经管道取)。restore 用**观察到的状态**证明,⛔ 不用退出码。

## ACCEPT — PR #13775

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. R34.

### ⭐ The mechanism is exact, and I verified it against the extractor rather than the report

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:2118`:

```js
if (!/^[\w.@][\w.@/*-]*$/.test(raw)) continue;
```

The admission test requires a literal to **begin** with a word character, `.` or `@`. The fix spells
the specifier `process.cwd()+'/scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs'`, so the quoted literal now starts with
`/` and is **refused outright** — before the module-relative resolve that doubled the prefix can even
run. ⭐ **The repair is entirely inside the producer's string**; the extractor is untouched, and
⛔ no change to `dispatch-gates.mjs` appears in the delivery, exactly as Zone 1 required.

### ⭐ The trap the obvious fix would have walked into

The natural repair — drop the `./` and write a bare `'scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs'` — **passes the
admission test**. ⇒ It would have replaced a *fabricated* hint with a *false but admitted* one,
silently handing this gate a watch population it does not read. ⛔ That is strictly worse than the
defect: a fabricated path is visibly impossible, a plausible wrong one is not. The dev named this
before choosing, and the docblock now carries `⛔ Do not "tidy" it back to a quoted relative
specifier` — ⭐ **which is the durable half.** Without that line the next cleanup re-introduces the bug,
and the comment also records why tightening the reader was refused (#13312's 8.6-populations-per-
fabrication price), so the next reader cannot re-litigate it from scratch.

### A2.2 — the census was run twice, at two scopes

| sweep | before | after |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| fleet, 333 tracked gate/tooling scripts, doubled-prefix class | **1 site** (this one) | **0** |
| same file, quoted module-relative literals | 4 — the other 3 are genuine sibling import specifiers the extractor already refuses | unchanged |
| extractor totals | hints 1500, dead 736 | hints **1499**, dead **735** |

⭐ **Exactly one removed, nothing else moved.** ⛔ That is the reading that makes "I fixed the one
site" checkable; a fleet sweep that found a second site would have changed the card's shape.

### A2.3 / A2.4 — both proven, and A2.4 in the strongest available form

**A2.3**: the mutate leg put the pre-fix relative spelling back, proved on disk by anchored `grep -c`
on **both** texts (injected 1 / removed 0) plus a blob hash away from HEAD's `cb30a9f9…`; the
extractor then read **4** hints *including* `scripts/scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs`. Restore proved by
**observed state** — `git diff HEAD` empty, blob back to `cb30a9f9…` exactly, grep counts inverted —
after which the extractor read **3** and the fabrication was gone. ⭐ Independently corroborated by
`dispatch-gates`' own self-test, which reads the edited file live and asserts the family still reaches
`content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, still claims `README.md` and `ARCHITECTURE.md`, and still claims
neither instruction file — ⛔ so the removal did not quietly take a real population with it.

**A2.4**: ⭐ the gate was **driven to its failure branch against a throwaway fixture root** to capture
the remedy text a human actually sees, and that line was then pasted verbatim at the repo root with
the placeholder filled in — exit 0, output
`objectstack-documentation / start-here / platform-modules / protocol--reference`, **byte-identical
(`diff` empty) to the same run under the old spelling.** ⛔ That is the difference between "it should
still work" and "I ran the string the user will actually be handed".

### A2.1 and gates

Defect re-confirmed live at the dev's own ref (`scripts/scripts` tracked = 0, control `scripts/` =
299) ⇒ ⛔ not absorbed by #13312's closing PR, so the card earned a PR rather than a close — the
branch the genealogy note reserved. 13 path-derived families **GREEN**, both gate-script convention
obligations **GREEN** (`dispatch-gates self-test: 1017 cases pass`), plus the gate's own suite and the
consumers that import `headingIds` from the edited file. `check-test-completeness` exit 3 ⇒
**NOT MEASURED** per its own text. ⭐ Repo-wide `pnpm lint` run **in full**, exit 0 in 2m02s —
⛔ no narrowing declared because none was taken. `skip-changeset` applied and read back
**comparatively** (labels now `size/s` + `skip-changeset`, nothing stripped) — the RMW discipline this
lane requires, not just an API 200.

⭐ Two observations correctly **not** filed: `check:stall-guard-headroom` is listed
unreachable-by-construction by the derivation itself on every run, and the 735 residual dead hints are
the fixture-constant class this card's own body assigns to #13312. Both already visible and owned
elsewhere ⇒ ⛔ filing them would have been duplication, not diligence.

### Disposition

⛔ Not governed surface (one `scripts/**` file), no clause ② limb. **Arming once its checks settle
green**; `Fixes #13449` closes this card on merge.
